rationale: The source is a mature brainstorm (2026-08-09) with a 'verified codebase state' section carrying ~40 file:line anchors that the whole 14-feature design leans on. Thirteen days of active dev have passed (FEAT-403..FEAT-442 landed). Research must (a) drift-verify every load-bearing anchor — especially the two AgentsFlow fix sites, the open crew/stream auth routes, the ContextVar-capture lines, and the Pulumi executor gaps — and (b) pull the evidence needed to resolve open questions the codebase can answer (ArtifactStore signing, CREW_RESULT_STORAGE default). No greenfield exploration is needed; localization is already claimed and only needs (re)confirmation.

queries.intent: Drift check: any commits since 2026-08-09 touching the core areas the design anchors to (flows, observability, clients/base, auth, storage, security, conf)
Drift check: commits since 2026-08-09 touching server handlers, app.py, and the Pulumi toolkit
Drift check: specs/proposals added since 2026-08-09 that might overlap the SaaS program (tenancy, metering, auth hardening already started elsewhere?)
Wiki orientation: is there any existing tenancy/tenant-middleware surface the brainstorm missed or that appeared since
